description: This file contains utility methods for testing view interactions in the AnySoftKeyboard project, including simulating touch gestures, clicking views, and verifying watermarks in input views. It also includes nested classes for representing finger movements and motion event data, as well as test methods for verifying gesture simulation correctness.

classes.name: ViewTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for simulating touch gestures, clicking views, and verifying watermarks in input views for testing purposes. It includes nested classes for representing finger movements and motion event data, as well as test methods for verifying gesture simulation correctness.

classes.name: Finger
classes.description: Represents a finger's start and end coordinates for simulating swipe gestures in tests.

classes.name: MotionEventData
classes.description: Captures details of MotionEvent objects for verification in tests.

methods.name: navigateFromTo
methods.description: Simulates a swipe gesture from a start point to an end point over a specified duration, with options to also send down and up events.

methods.name: navigateByClicking
methods.description: Simulates a click on a view within a fragment and returns the current fragment after the click.

methods.name: performClick
methods.description: Performs a click action on a Preference object.

methods.name: assertCurrentWatermark
methods.description: Verifies that the current watermark in an InputViewBinder contains or does not contain a specific drawable resource.

methods.name: assertZeroWatermarkInteractions
methods.description: Verifies that no watermarks have been set on the InputViewBinder.

methods.name: assertCurrentWatermarkHasDrawable
methods.description: Checks that the current watermark includes a specific drawable resource.

methods.name: assertCurrentWatermarkDoesNotHaveDrawable
methods.description: Checks that the current watermark does not include a specific drawable resource.
